Witness Statement: Morning Discovery in Copy/Records Room
Sworn statement from a finance staff member describing the 2026-03-13 morning discovery in the copy/records room, including immediate scene observations and what was seen on the FIN-WS-03 workstation. Notes include the shared reimbursement folder path and a visible modified-time window for Packet_0312 receipt PDFs (19:26–19:31 on 2026-03-12).
WITNESS STATEMENT
Morning Discovery in Copy/Records Room (Finance Suite) — Portland, Oregon
CONFIDENTIAL · INTERNAL USE ONLY

STATEMENT OF
I am an employee in the finance department in the downtown office in Portland. I am giving this statement about what I saw the morning the victim was found in the copy/records room.

I understand this statement may be used in a criminal investigation. I swear/affirm the information I provide is true and correct to the best of my knowledge.
Oath / Advisement
I was advised that giving false information is a crime. I am providing this statement voluntarily.
Narrative
On 2026-03-13, I arrived to work in the morning and went into the finance suite. I walked toward the copy/records room area.

When I opened the copy/records room, I saw the victim on the floor and she was not responding. I backed out and notified others and 911 was called. I did not move anything in the room.

Before police arrived, I noticed the workstation in the copy/records room was on. I did not sit down and work, but I looked at the monitor from where I was standing. A file window was open to a shared folder path that I recognized as:

- `Finance\Reimbursements\Q1\Packet_0312`

In that folder view, I could see receipt PDFs listed, and I could see the “Date modified” column. I remember the modified times were clustered late the prior evening. The times I saw on the screen were between approximately 19:26 and 19:31 on 2026-03-12 for multiple receipt PDFs in that Packet_0312 folder.

I did not click into any files, print anything, or change anything. After noticing the folder listing, I left the area and waited for instructions.
Specific On-Screen Details Recalled
Shared folder path observed
Finance\Reimbursements\Q1\Packet_0312
Modified-time window observed in folder listing
Between 2026-03-12 19:26 and 2026-03-12 19:31 (as shown in the “Date modified” column)
Interaction with workstation/files
Witness states they only looked at the screen; did not click/open/print/modify anything.
Limitations
Witness describes what was visible on the workstation screen at the time of discovery and recalls the folder path and a modified-time range. The statement does not, by itself, identify who made the modifications or which specific PDFs were changed.
Documented observations
- A shared folder named "Finance\Reimbursements\Q1\Packet_0312" shows receipt PDFs modified between "2026-03-12 19:26" and "2026-03-12 19:31" in the file server audit view.
